key.name: Cumulative integration tests (IT2-00 through IT2-11)
key.steps: IT2-00 Schema and migration convergence (apply current main migrations; apply every candidate migration in intended order; run prisma migrate deploy; compare schema drift; rollback through forward-fix rehearsal; verify no table/model collisions). IT2-01 Formal-to-code conformance (model-check specifications; run generated command sequences against implementation; preserve minimized counterexamples; fail if implementation transition is absent from the model or vice versa without an explicit abstraction record). IT2-02 Full invocation/economic path (AiTaskIntent → reviewed task policy → unique invocation claim → provider admission → cash or credit reservation → exact provider attempt → ambiguous/success/failure state → reconciliation → telemetry and disclosure receipt; test every failure boundary). IT2-03 Credit oversubscription (verified remaining credit = $1.00; 100 concurrent requests × $0.02 → no more than 50 admitted → no negative balance → ambiguous attempts remain held). IT2-04 Context correctness (modify one central symbol; ensure context root changes; affected tests/owners enter the pack; unrelated files do not flood the budget; old pack is marked stale). IT2-05 Process conformance (inject: skipped review; duplicate retry; different-reviewer violation; owner prompt before prerequisites; repeated dead-letter loop; unexpected state transition; all must be detected and reason-coded). IT2-06 Solver integrity (impossible schedule returns INFEASIBLE, not a relaxed unsafe plan; time limit returns FEASIBLE or UNKNOWN honestly; owner-minute and cash constraints remain hard; minor input changes do not cause uncontrolled plan churn). IT2-07 Shadow statistics (repeated peeking does not invalidate evidence method; stopping rules preregistered; guardrail harm stops the shadow; low sample stays inconclusive; no result is relabeled causal without identification). IT2-08 Autonomy decay (change model version; expire eval suite; inject drift; increase owner overturn rate; consume error budget → the system downgrades or recommends downgrade; it never promotes automatically). IT2-09 Capsule escape attempts (undeclared host function; private-network request; forbidden file path; memory excess; infinite loop; oversized output; hash mismatch → every attempt fails closed with a receipt). IT2-10 Activation rollback (shadow variant activates only with owner receipt; exposure limit reached; kill switch fires; rollback restores previous variant; flag evaluation receipt remains append-only). IT2-11 Assurance traceability (every supported assurance claim must trace to immutable evidence at exact versions; removing or staling a receipt downgrades the claim automatically).

key.name: Formal Invariant Foundry: specs + safety property sets
key.steps: Benchmark TLA+/TLC (explicit-state checking of finite models) vs Apalache (bounded symbolic checking and inductive-invariant analysis through SMT); neither becomes a runtime dependency; specs and counterexample receipts live in the repository. Create formal/ specs: ai-invocation/InvocationClaim.tla, cash-budget/CashReservation.tla, credit-budget/CreditReservation.tla, provider-attempt/ProviderAttempt.tla, checkout/CheckoutAttempt.tla, settlement/SettlementEpisode.tla, outbox/TransactionalDelivery.tla, autonomy/AutonomyGrant.tla. Each spec must define: state variables; initial state; legal transitions; safety invariants; liveness assumptions separately from safety; bounded constants used by the checker; implementation symbols/PRs the model corresponds to; known abstractions and omitted behavior; tool/version/checksum; model-check receipt hash. Required safety properties — Invocation: AtMostOneClaimOwner, AtMostOneExternalDispatchPerAttempt, SameIdDifferentFingerprintNeverExecutes, AmbiguousAttemptStopsFallback, TerminalReplayReturnsSameResultReference. Cash and credits: ReservedPlusSettledNeverExceedsCap, CreditAvailableNeverNegative, AmbiguousExposureNeverAutoReleases, AllScopeReservationsCommitOrRollbackTogether, ProviderIdentityNeverImpliesPayer. Checkout: SameIntentSameFingerprintSameStripeKey, SameIntentDifferentFingerprintConflicts, AmbiguousNetworkOutcomeRetainsKey, CompletedAttemptNeverRegresses, WebhookReplayIsIdempotent. Settlement and delivery: RetryDoesNotCreateCorroboration, OneSourceObservationCountsOnce, ResolvedEpisodeHistoryPersists, DomainCommitCannotLoseOutboxEvent, DeliveryFailureCannotBecomeDelivered, DeadLetterCapCannotBeBypassed. Autonomy: NoSelfApproval, ExpiredGrantCannotExecute, PolicyOrModelDriftInvalidatesGrant, ExternalIrreversibleActionRequiresOwnerReceipt, AuthorityNeverExpandsDuringExecution. Implementation conformance: for every formal state transition create a model-based fast-check command; generated command sequences run against pure in-memory reference state, repository implementation adapters, and disposable PostgreSQL where persistence is load-bearing; failing properties' minimized counterexamples preserved as reports/formal-counterexamples/<domain>/<receipt-id>.json, then converted into permanent regression tests. Chaos matrix: deterministic Toxiproxy scenarios at boundaries (app↔PostgreSQL; app↔Stripe test endpoint or local stub; control plane↔provider adapter stub; worker↔delivery provider stub; source runtime↔official-source fixture server) with fault points (before request bytes; mid-request; request accepted / response lost; partial response; slow response; connection reset; retry after restart; DB commit succeeded / acknowledgement lost; outbox claimed / worker died; telemetry unavailable; clock skew and lease expiry); every chaos run records its seed and exact toxic configuration.

key.topic: whether a recovered book sigma/mu is an edge detector
key.claim_a: The reconstructed DK distributions are an edge detector and a free projection feed: project mu from nflverse EPA, price with DK's own sigma table, edge = our mu vs DK mu_hat > 0.4 sigma; if our mu differs from DK's mu_hat by > ~0.4 sigma, the prop is live
key.claim_b: Edge claims on this data do not survive: the model has negative standalone skill (Brier 0.251 vs market 0.220), ~190 specs out of sample produced nothing, the first positive in ~190 specs is a calibration transform not an edge, and it collapses the 82 spurious positive edge rows

key.topic: whether the rating/team-model stack is a prediction engine or a calibration-only artifact
